slice: Lead integration of the H2b time-source probe, H2c real-model core probe and H5b checkpoint availability probe into Runtime and tools
purpose: Land the three verified integration surfaces: owner-only zero-model time-source probe, owner-only bounded real-model core event-tool probe, owner-only read-only checkpoint availability probe; each receipt is cached only in snapshot diagnostics and no business state is written.

baseline.head: 50e347d
baseline.note: previous round HEAD; round-4 slices committed on top

changes.runtimeH2b: imports probeTimeSource/TimeSourceProbeResult, adds lastTimeSourceProbe, dispatches runtime.probe-time-source and implements commandTimeSourceProbe with session.probe admission (paused rejection, shared capacity, abortable, no retry, no model/Task/Effect); snapshot diagnostics exposes timeSourceProbe.
changes.runtimeH2c: adds CoreDriver.probeCoreEventToolModelRound, lastCoreModelToolProbe, runtime.probe-core-model-tools command (single-flight phase guard, paused admission, 60s timeout, maxTokens 256, honest receipt including failed/unknown/cancelled, no retry) and diagnostics.coreModelToolProbe.
changes.runtimeH5b: applies the checkpoint probe diff: owner-only runtime.checkpoint.probe dispatched before ensureCanRun (paused readable), RuntimeCheckpointProbeCommand with validated receipt and diagnostics.checkpointProbe; capture command remains explicitly unavailable without trusted composition.
changes.indexTools: registers three owner-facing diagnostic tools: shiyu_diagnose_time_source, shiyu_diagnose_core_model_tools, shiyu_diagnose_checkpoint_availability (all parameterless, non-concurrency-safe, no model/replyer/worker restricted mounting); existing status/worker/core tools unchanged.
changes.localCoreSeam: adds the thin LocalCoreService delegation probeCoreEventToolModelRound to the core adapter so the Runtime CoreDriver path can reach it (the adapter owns behavior; the seam adds no policy).
changes.tests: host-diagnostics-tool tests assert each new tool executes exactly its owner command with closed parameters; the round integrated isolated check covers all round-4 slices plus this integration.

leadIntegratedIsolatedCheck.tool: scripts/slice-verify.mjs (isolated worktree at HEAD 50e347d + all round-4 slice files and the integration files; node_modules + pinned Python symlinked)
leadIntegratedIsolatedCheck.arithmetic: 1435 baseline + 9 H2b + 9 H2c + 10 H5b + 6 H7 + 3 tool-definition tests = 1472

verification.hostValidationPending: fixed-host zero-model probes and the single bounded real-model core tool probe are executed next and committed separately.

knownLimitations: All three probes are diagnostics only; they do not prove production time triggering, real Session log export, Ombre export readiness or real plan quality.
The real-model core probe depends on provider behavior and usage reporting; a failed/unknown outcome must be recorded honestly and must not be retried automatically.
The checkpoint capture command remains explicitly unavailable without trusted staging/manifest composition.
evidenceLevel: G1 integration + isolated full check; fixed-host validation pending.
